meta.methodology: OctaSpace prices are live averages of current marketplace asking prices, refreshed in your browser. Competitor prices are verified on the dates shown. vast.name: Vast.ai
vast.note: Index of verified-host listings refreshed from the madebyagents.com GPU-rental price index, which aggregates the Vast.ai public API — figures are pulled via that third-party index, not queried from Vast.ai directly. Vast.ai figures are the cheapest offer found ('from' prices, spot tier) — the marketplace moves hourly, so treat these as directional. Pulled 2026-09-30 ~14:51 UTC (index refreshed 2:43 PM UTC). H100 = H100 SXM 80GB HBM3 variant. 5 moved this pull: 3090 $0.12->$0.08, 4080 $0.14->$0.13 (new plain-4080 Vast.ai spot headline), 4090 $0.20->$0.22, 5070 $0.11->$0.10, 5080 $0.17->$0.16; 4070 and 5090 unchanged ($0.08 / $0.25). RTX A6000 cell retains the 2026-09-28 pull ($0.13): today's pull has no Vast.ai spot headline for that SKU (cheapest listed is RunPod Community $0.33). A100 cell retains the 2026-09-27 snapshot ($0.75): today's pull lists only 80GB SXM spot ($0.47) and 80GB PCIe spot ($0.40) headlines — neither matches this row's 40GB SXM4 SKU. H100 SXM cell retains $0.89: the index is internally inconsistent this pull (table row shows Vast.ai Spot $1.00/hr, but its Popular-GPUs card says 'From $1.73/hr on Vast.ai'), so the figure is left untouched rather than recording a disputed number.

saladcloud.name: SaladCloud
saladcloud.note: Official published 'from' rates on the Lowest priority tier (four tiers: High, Medium, Low, Lowest — lower tiers can be preempted by higher-priority workloads).
